# Kumārapañhā (Kp 4 (PTS Kp 2))

**ID:** Kp 4 (PTS Kp 2)
**Section:** Khuddakapāṭha (kp)
**Collection:** Suttas-Early-2
**Title (Pali):** Kumārapañhā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0501m.mul3.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Kumārapañhā* ("The Boy’s Questions" or "Novice’s Questions") is the fourth text of the *Khuddakapāṭha* [Hazra 1994; Williams and Ladwig 2012]. Functioning as a catechism of ten questions for novices, it sets forth a succinct *mātikā* or mnemonic summary of the Dhamma arranged in a numerical progression from one to ten [Humphreys 1956; Gyatso 1992; Hazra 1994]. It begins with the fundamental question "What is one? All beings persist on food" (*sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā*), followed by "What is two? Name and form" (*nāmañca rūpañca*), and "What is three? The three feelings" [Hazra 1994]. It proceeds through key doctrinal categories, identifying four as the noble truths, five as the aggregates of clinging (*upādānakkhandha*), seven as the enlightenment factors (*bojjhaṅga*), eight as the noble eightfold path, and ten as the qualities of an arahant [Gethin 2001; Bodhi 2012]. While related numerical discourses in the Nikāyas frame these sets in relation to disenchantment and dispassion, the *Kumārapañhā* compiles them as positive doctrinal sets to be memorized as an essential distillation of the teaching [Gyatso 1992; Bodhi 2012].

 The listing formula also matches passages in the *Ñāṇakathā* of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* [Ñāṇamoli 1952], a connection confirmed by DharmaNexus, which identifies six shared passages between *Kumārapañhā* and the *Ñāṇakathā* (Ps 1.1, spanning segments 1.2–7.2) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns the text with cross-language parallels, including the Sanskrit *Mahāsāhasrapramardanī* and Tibetan translations of the *Śatasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā* and *Vasantatilakaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. The text is commented upon in the *Paramatthajotikā* I [von Hinüber 1996].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Resembling parallels: AN 10.27 Paṭhamamahāpañhāsutta; EA 46.8 十論; SĀ 486-489; AN 10.28 Dutiyamahāpañhāsutta

- Cross-language matches (DharmaNexus): Mahāsāhasrapramardanī (SA_K12_mspram_u) [sa]; དཔྱིད་ཀྱི་ཐིག་ལེའི་རྒྱ་ཆེར་འགྲེལ་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བ (vasantatilakaṭīkā-nāma) (D1449) [bo]; ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ་སྟོང་ཕྲག་བརྒྱ་པ། (śatasāhasrikā-prajñāpāramitā) (D0008-11) [bo]
